name: Fix Mode: Test Data Dependency Resolution
passCriteria: Reads failure.log and categorizes root cause as 'Test Data' or 'State Management'
Identifies that test expects specific product to exist but inventory changed
Suggests data-independent approach (e.g., using first available product, data fixtures, or dynamic selection)
Does NOT weaken assertions to match stale data
Produces fix that makes test resilient to data changes
failCriteria: Modifies assertions to match current wrong data (e.g., expects 5 products instead of 6)
Skips the test or marks it as expected to fail
Misidentifies root cause as selector or timing issue
Keeps hard-coded product expectations without data setup
